items.question: In which month of the current fiscal year does the UAE Minister of Finance issue the circular on preparing the next year's federal draft budget?
items.gold: The third month of the present fiscal year.
items.fact: Budget preparation circular issued in third month of fiscal year

items.question: How many months does the UAE federal fiscal year comprise?
items.gold: 12 months, starting January 1 and ending December 31.
items.fact: Federal fiscal year has 12 months, January to December
